messages:
alex: Idea: introduce \"queue gardens\" as a placement+shaping abstraction for the batcher. each garden groups queues by locality (kv-warm, slab affinity, region) and exposes a tiny admission surface (target_window_ms, max_tokens, headroom_pct). keep lanes for QoS, gardens for placement.
mira: short version: gardens decide how to size windows based on locality and kernel efficiency, lanes still decide priority. ok, why another surface?
alex: lanes are logical QoS. gardens are physical: they inform placement + window sizing so we batch in cache-local ways. helps avoid cross-tenant kv pollution in a single slab.
sanjay: adding surfaces increases operational complexity. who owns garden config? runtime heuristics or ops?
carol: ops should not manually tune per-customer by default. rule-based defaults from telemetry, with an opt-in autotune service as later work.
alex: proposed default rule: target_window_ms = clamp(1.5 * p50_latency, 2ms, 60ms) for cache-hot gardens, and higher for cold. headroom_pct conservative to start.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: pushed batcher-config v0.7.3 to canary - garden-defaults enabled :rocket:
mira: we need a borrowing contract between gardens to avoid one garden starving others by using shared GPU headroom.
sanjay: tradeoff: strict borrowing -> lower utilization; loose borrowing -> broken latency isolation. suggest global_deficit_pool (e.g., 8% of headroom) + per-garden cooldowns.
carol: observability must record token provenance (origin garden id, borrowed_amt, before/after percentiles). add sampling traces for borrowed batches to correlate regressions.
alex: rollout plan: gate garden placement behind a runtime flag; console shows garden charts and headroom metrics. start with two gardens: hot_local and shared_cold.
sanjay: can we fuzz in the emulator with bursty tenants vs steady background to find monopolization edge cases?
carol: yes, I'll add a 24h fuzz test with randomized hotspots measuring tail latency and utilization.
alex: minimal config example for discussion:
```json
{
  "gardens": [
    {"id":"hot_local","target_window_ms":8,"headroom_pct":12},
    {"id":"shared_cold","target_window_ms":40,"headroom_pct":6}
  ],
  "global_deficit_pool_pct":8,
  "borrowing_cooldown_ms":200
}
```
mira: UX ask: make garden ids human-readable and map to GPU slab id in logs. saves time during debugging.
sanjay: customer-facing surface should be opt-out: auto-mode on by default, expert-mode for advanced customers.
carol: next steps: implement garden metadata in placement layer, add emulator fuzz + dashboard panels, canary on Dedicated, observe headroom and tail latency, then roll to Hosted.
alex: i'll open a follow-up RFC with API and telemetry fields. tagging @sanjay @carol to keep momentum. :+1:
